QUOTE: Unknown keys in an inline `options` manifest.** Refused. Silently ignoring them would report a statement as honoured when it was not.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says unknown keys in the options manifest are refused, but it doesn't say an unknown section is refused by name against the allowed set. It also doesn't give the reason that an ignored section builds with defaults while reporting the declaration was honoured.
